title: convertContainedStringsToChars
summary: Convert string values and strings contained in cells and structs to character vectors.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU kernel is needed. Non-string members, including resident integer arrays, pass through unchanged without provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: [out1, ...] = convertContainedStringsToChars(value1, ...) - Convert top-level or contained string values to character vectors.
behaviors: Convert top-level string scalars and arrays, and string values contained at arbitrary cell/struct nesting depth, while preserving container shape and every non-string member exactly.
Variadic inputs convert independently to corresponding variadic outputs.
Empty and missing string scalars convert to 0-by-0 character arrays.
examples: convertContainedStringsToChars(C) converts string values nested in cells or structs to character vectors.
